summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the default standard in 2026 for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services through a unified interface. The ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations, gateways that handle auth and routing at scale, and individual servers that expose specific tools like browsers, repos, and databases. This matters because MCP lets agents act with real agency—reading code, driving browsers, querying databases—without bespoke integrations for each capability.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (Composio, Smithery, mcp.so) are marketplaces that give agents one-click access to many MCP servers; gateways (agentgateway, Cloudflare MCP, Kong MCP) are infrastructure that centralize auth, discovery, and secure routing across servers; individual servers (GitHub MCP, Playwright MCP) each expose a single tool or service to the agent.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Repositories, issues, pull requests, code search, CI/CD workflows, and GitHub APIs
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; GitHub Copilot from $10/mo (Pro) and $19/user/mo (Business)
strengths: Deep integration with repos, PRs, and issues
Ubiquitous in Cursor, Claude, and agent workflows
tools.best_for: Automating repository management, code review, and development workflows from AI agents

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, web scraping, end-to-end testing, and page interaction via accessibility tree
tools.best_for: Giving agents the ability to browse, test, and interact with web applications

tools.name: Filesystem MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Local file read/write, directory traversal, and file search on the developer's machine
strengths: Core primitive for local-file agent workflows
tools.best_for: Local file access and manipulation in Cursor, Claude Desktop, and IDE agents

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Thousands of hosted MCP servers and tools with managed auth, credentials, and sessions
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based and team plans for hosted deployments
strengths: Handles auth, credentials, and sessions automatically
tools.best_for: Quickly connecting agents to a broad catalog of tools without managing infrastructure

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ app integrations (Slack, Gmail, Notion, Jira, GitHub) with managed OAuth and tool-calling
tools.pricing_paid: Paid tiers scale with active connections and API usage
strengths: Deep managed authentication across SaaS apps
tools.best_for: Building production agents that act across many SaaS applications

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, auth, storage, and Supabase project management
tools.pricing_paid: Supabase from $25/mo (Pro); MCP server itself is free
strengths: Lets agents query and manage schema directly
tools.best_for: Agents that read, write, and manage Postgres data and backend services

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP hosting, Workers, D1, R2, KV, and OAuth-secured remote servers
tools.pricing_paid: Workers Paid from $5/mo plus usage-based pricing
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting with OAuth
Official SDK and multiple ready-made servers
tools.best_for: Deploying and hosting secure remote MCP servers at scale

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, search, and content creation/editing
tools.pricing_paid: Notion from $10/user/mo; MCP server is free
strengths: Strong for docs and knowledge-base workflows
Widely adopted for agent note-taking and PM
tools.best_for: Agents managing documentation, notes, and project data in Notion

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, components, and design-to-code extraction
tools.pricing_paid: Figma from $3/editor/mo (Dev Mode access varies by plan)
strengths: Official design-context server for coding agents
tools.best_for: Translating Figma designs into code within AI coding tools

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Error tracking, issues, performance monitoring, and stack-trace analysis
tools.pricing_paid: Sentry from $26/mo (Team); MCP server is free
strengths: Lets agents triage and debug production errors
tools.best_for: Agents debugging and resolving production errors and incidents

tools.name: Docker MCP Toolkit
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers, image management, and a curated MCP catalog via Docker Desktop
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Pro from $9/mo; Team/Business tiers for orgs
strengths: Built-in catalog and gateway in Docker Desktop
tools.best_for: Running and managing MCP servers securely in isolated containers

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Payments, invoices, subscriptions, customers, and Stripe API operations
tools.pricing_paid: Stripe usage-based (2.9% + 30¢ per transaction); MCP server is free
tools.best_for: Agents handling payments, billing, and subscription management
